_meta.notes: Yahoo Finance limits 1m data to ~7 days; 1h candles provide 2,162 bars per asset over 90 days, sufficient for all strategies.

orb.reason: ORB is fundamentally incompatible with 24/7 crypto markets. The strategy returned -55.16% average across symbols (1,435 trades at 20.4% win rate). Without a fixed market open, the 'opening range' resets constantly, generating hundreds of false breakout signals per symbol. Disable for crypto.
orb.cryptoAdaptation: If re-enabled, use midnight UTC as session start and treat the first 1h candle as the opening range. Requires explicit daily windowing not in the current runner.

reversal.recommendation: Keep with stock params (RSI 70/30) — signals are rare but high quality. Crypto 60/40 generates 3.5× more trades but lower win rate and negative returns.

stockParams_70_30.note: Few signals but marginally positive. ETH best performer at +0.97%.

cryptoTuned_60_40.note: More frequent but noisier signals — lower RSI thresholds catch weaker reversals.

params._cryptoNote: Stock RSI 70/30 outperforms 60/40 for crypto. Crypto's mean-reversion moves are most reliable at true extremes. Consider 75/25 for even higher selectivity.

cryptoAdjustments.vwapSession: Reset VWAP at midnight UTC instead of market open for 24/7 trading
cryptoAdjustments.volumeClimax: 2× average volume threshold unchanged — effective for crypto as crypto volume spikes on reversals too
cryptoAdjustments.stopLossMultiplier: 3:1 R:R unchanged — crypto has fat tails so the extra reward compensates for higher stop-outs

macdBollinger.recommendation: Best-performing crypto strategy. Crypto-tuned params delivered +1.73% avg return with 41.7% win rate. ETH specifically returned +6.55% over 90 days. Use these params for all crypto assets.

_reasoning.bbPeriod: Reduced from 20→14: shorter period makes Bollinger Bands more responsive to crypto's rapid price cycles. Avoids signal lag that causes missed entries.
_reasoning.bbMultiplier: Widened from 2.0→2.5: crypto moves 2–5× more than stocks per day. Wider bands prevent false signals from normal crypto volatility being mistaken for BB extremes.
_reasoning.volumeMultiplier: Lowered from 1.5→1.2: crypto trades continuously so volume is more evenly distributed vs. stocks' session-based spikes. 1.2× still confirms momentum without being too restrictive.

cryptoAdjustments.macdPeriods: Default 12/26/9 unchanged — these periods work well for 1h crypto candles
cryptoAdjustments.stopLoss: Uses opposite BB band — naturally wider in crypto due to larger bbMultiplier, giving appropriate stops for volatile moves
cryptoAdjustments.riskReward: 2:1 R:R unchanged — effective given MACD-BB's directional accuracy

ichimoku.recommendation: Deprioritize for crypto. Avg win rate 13.1%, avg return -3.69%. SOL performed worst at -9.47% with only 10.7% win rate. The 9/26/52 Ichimoku periods (designed for 5-day trading weeks) do not map well onto 24/7 crypto markets.

params._cryptoNote: Standard 9/26/52 periods assume 5-day trading week. For 24/7 crypto, convert: tenkan=7 (1 week in hours/4h), kijun=22, senkou=44. Retest with 4h candles. Not implemented in current strategy.

ichimoku.cryptoRecommendation: If keeping Ichimoku for crypto, use 4h candles with adjusted periods (7/22/44) to align with 7-day crypto weeks instead of 5-day stock weeks. Current implementation should be disabled for crypto until re-parameterized.

globalCryptoSettings.volatilityNote: Crypto daily volatility is 2–5× stocks. All fixed-dollar stops from stock strategies must be re-scaled. The strategies' percentage-based stops (using price distance) adapt automatically.
globalCryptoSettings.preferredInterval: 1h candles for signal generation; 1m available for last 7 days only via Yahoo Finance
globalCryptoSettings.symbolFormat: Yahoo Finance format: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, DOGE-USD, etc.
